title: Porphyromonas gingivalis–Induced NETs Mediate Neuroinflammation via TLR4 Activation
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1612-1621, November 2026.
Periodontitis, caused by periodontal pathogens such asPorphyromonas gingivalis, is a risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) progression. Neutrophils, which are abundant in patients with periodontitis, release neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) to ...
